name: Can I customize my pre-construction condo unit?

mainEntity.name: Can I customize my pre-construction condo unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many pre-construction developers offer customization options, especially for early buyers. This can range from selecting finishes like flooring, countertops, and cabinetry to sometimes making minor layout modifications. The extent of customization depends on the developer and the project's stage. Understanding the available options and upgrade costs is a key preparation step before committing to a purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many developers allow customization of finishes and sometimes layouts, especially for early buyers. The options vary by project and stage.
